newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy bourse valued at minimum 40bln lire for sale.
newsitem.headline: Italy bourse valued at minimum 40bln lire for sale.

text.p: The Italian Treasury set a minimum 40 billion lire on the value of the Italian stock exchange for its transformation into a private company.
A Treasury statement said the sale of shares will be carried out through competitive tender with 51 percent of the stock reserved for current stock market operators.
It said apart from this category, bids from other investment companies, banks, funds and insurers will also be considered on an individual basis.
No one taking part in the tender will be able to take more than a five percent stake in the new company, it said.
The Treasury gave no timetable for the long planned privatisation of the stock market.

"The operation is aimed at involving interested parties in the process of the market's transformation and encouraging the creation of a controlling framework which is able to guarantee the development of the market," it said.
The Treasury has issued a decree concerning the criteria and procedural methods for privatisation but gave no further details.
